items.title: Sinner moves within 50 points of Alcaraz in Live Race after Miami title
items.summary:
Three months into the 2026 season and just 50 points separate Carlos Alcaraz and Jannik Sinner in the PIF ATP Live Race To Turin.

Alcaraz began the year with title runs at the Australian Open and at the ATP 500 in Doha, building a 16-match winning streak that ended in the Indian Wells semi-finals.
